teaser: Hands on the wrench, you give the bolt one more quarter-turn before trusting the wheel to hold. You are a 4 and an ENTJ, and both sides of you check their work the same way: by whether it holds weight. What's particular to this crossing isn't caution and it isn't speed. It's a drive to build something load-bearing on a deadline nobody else set, and to stand on it before admitting it might need more time.
excerpt: 'You don't have to fix it, I just needed you to listen.'
